svg.aria-label: Preparation of aldehydes and ketones by oxidation or dehydrogenation of alcohols
svg.title: Preparation of aldehydes and ketones by oxidation or dehydrogenation of alcohols

g.text: Preparation 1: oxidation and dehydrogenation of alcohols
(a) Primary alcohol → aldehyde (stop the oxidation by distilling the aldehyde out, or use PCC)
(b) Secondary alcohol → ketone (no further oxidation without C–C cleavage)
(c) Catalytic dehydrogenation of alcohol vapour over Cu at 573 K (no oxidising agent)
